messages:
alex: quick heads-up — i'm blocked on merging a chain of PRs that need to land in the same window today. sdk#988 -> depends on api#412 (auth header rename). console#620 pulls the new sdk. helm chart needs runtime image bump after runtime team publishes. can we sequence this?

maria: links + CI status? i can review api if tests look good.

alex: links: api#412 -> https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/412 (unit tests passing, e2e flaky), sdk#988 -> https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/988 (needs api changes), console#620 -> https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/620 (fails e2e due to header). ci locally: api pass, sdk pass, console e2e 1/3 failing.

sasha: runtime note — we have a deploy scheduled at 17:00 UTC. runtime image for the new kv-cache change will be published around that time. helm needs that image tag. i'd prefer we don't merge helm until runtime image is available.

jen: i can take a quick sdk review — will check for compatibility shims (if api rename is additive or breaking). if it's additive we can do staged rollout.

priyam: console e2e failing because the frontend expects header `x-rdw-auth` — api#412 renames to `x-rdw-client`. small fix on console side but i want to avoid double-deploy if possible. snippet from failing test: `Expected: x-rdw-auth, Received: x-rdw-client`

alex: thanks — option: add compatibility shim in api (accept both headers) for a short window, merge sdk+console, then drop shim after one release. would avoid parallel deploys. comments?

andrew: i can open a 30-min merge window at 16:00 PDT (23:00 UTC) and coordinate merges. prefer this ordering: 1) api (with shim), 2) sdk, 3) console, 4) runtime image + helm. but runtime must publish image before helm step.

ci-bot: api#412 — CI: unit ✅, integration ✅, e2e flaky (2/3) — tagging flaky tests (infra/team-alert).

maria: i'll prioritize api review now. quick Q: is shim just header fallback? if so +1 from me once tests are stable.

sasha: i'll publish runtime image `runtime:v2.3.1-rc` as soon as we confirm api/sdk/console merges. then jen/andrew you can patch helm values to point to that tag.

jen: reviewed sdk — 1 nit (doc comment), otherwise LGTM. will approve after doc fix.

priyam: i'll push a tiny console compat patch (add fallback header) in ~25m and request review. should make console e2e green.

alex: summary / action items: 
- maria: final api review + confirm shim implementation (accept both headers)
- jen: approve sdk after doc nit fix (~10m)
- priyam: push console compat patch (~25m)
- sasha: hold runtime publish until we have merge completion signal, will push `runtime:v2.3.1-rc`
- andrew: open merge window 16:00 PDT, will coordinate order and watch CI

please react with :+1: when you can merge in the window or with :hourglass: if you need more time. i'll hold merges until we have at least maria+jen+priyam ready.

maria: +1, will merge api with shim if ci stabilizes.

sasha: :+1: will stand by for publish.

jen: pushed doc fix, approved sdk — ready.

priyam: pushed console fix and requested review, CI running.

alex: perfect — i'll coordinate the merge window. thanks everyone.
